It has myriad roles and responsibilities from supporting Central Line Ministries and State Government

management, strategy formulation & implementation of Eme rging Technologies viz. AI, Blockchain, GIS etc., 
to facilitating digital diplomacy with focus on Indian startups and products. 
 
NeGD has been a leader in implementation and execution of a gamut of pilot/ infrastructure/ technical/ special 
projects and support components to framing core policies, project appraisals, R&D, and guiding /conducting 
assessments, undertaking activities fo r building capacities of both Government oﬃcials and other 
stakeholders, and creating mass awareness about schemes and services under the Digital India Programme.  
 
National e-Governance Division (NeGD) is currently inviting applications for 4 Co-Lead positions purely on a

nationwide digital interventions, handholding  Central Ministries and State/UT Governments, collaborating 
with industry/academia/startups, and driving proactive Business Development and institutional

About National e-Governance Division (NeGD) 
 
The National e-Governance Division has been set up by the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology 
as an Independent Business Division under the Digital India Corporation {erstwhile Media Lab Asia}. Since 
2009, NeGD has been playing a pivotal role in supporting MeitY in Programme Management and 
implementation of the e -Governance Projects; providing technical and advisory support to Ministries/ 
Departments, both at Central and State levels along with other Government organizations. NeGD’s  major 
operational areas include programme management, project development, technology management, capacity 
building, awareness and communications-related activities under the flagship Digital India Programme. NeGD 
has developed and is managing several Nat ional Public Digital Platforms such as DigiLocker, UMANG, Rapid 
Assessment System, OpenForge, API Setu, Poshan Tracker, Academic Bank of Credits, National Academic 
Depositories, National AI Portal, MyScheme, India Stack Global, Meri Pehchaan, etc. 
 
The roles and responsibilities of NeGD are as follows: 
1. Providing strategic direction in terms of framing policies and implementation strategy for the Digital 
India Programme in different domains of e-Governance 
2. Proactive support to Central and State Governments for Mission Mode Projects and other e -
Governance projects 
3. Acting as a facilitator and catalyst for the implementation of the Digital India Program by various 
Ministries and State Governments 
4. Providing technical assistance to Central Ministries/ State Line Departments in their e -Governance 
projects either directly or in collaboration with professional consultants 
5. Undertaking technical appraisal of e-Governance projects for examining issues like overall technology, 
architecture, framework standards, security policy, service delivery mechanism, sharing of common 
infrastructure, etc 
6. Developing generic / model Expression of Interest, Request for Proposal, Standard Contracts, PPP 
Models and other related documents for various stages and requirements of projects for use by the 
States 
7. Ensuring effective citizen engagement and communication with all stakeholders using offline and 
Social Media channels 
8. Impact assessment of e-governance projects of all States / UTs 
9. Recruitment, deployment and HR management of specialised resources in the State e -Governance 
Mission Teams in all States and UTs 
10. Enhancing governance through knowledge and capacity building 
 
More details can be seen at https://negd.gov.in/. 
 
 
About Digital India Corporation (DIC) 
 
The Digital India Corporation (formerly Media Lab Asia) has been set up by the Ministry of Electronics and 
Information Technology (MeitY ), Government of India, to innovate, develop and deploy ICT and other 
emerging technologies for the benefit of the common man. Digital India Corporation plays the role of a leader 
in promoting e-Governance by taking forward the projects and activities of t he Digital India Programme, to 
facilitate its stakeholders to realise its goals. It also provides strategic support to Ministries & Departments, 
both at the Central and State level for carrying forward the mission of the Digital India Programme by way of 
Capacity Building for e -Governance projects, promoting best practices, encouraging Public -Private 
Partnerships (PPP), nurturing innovation and technology in various domains.  
 
Digital India Corporation has several Independent Business Divisions under it and these include NeGD, MyGov, 
Bhashini, ISM, IndiaAI and MSH. 
 
Digital India Corporation entails following responsibilities: 
1. To provide leadership and support to the Government of India through MeitY; to steer and anchor the 
Digital India Programme along with related policy and implementation initiatives. 
2. To support MeitY  about policy and implementation -related issues concerning various ongoing 
programmes & schemes in the ICT domain as well as new initiatives undertaken as part of the Digital 
India Programme. 
3. To support Ministries/Departments, both at Centre and States, as well as other stakeholders in crafting 
e-Governance strategies, to further promote Accountability, Efficiency, Efficacy and Transparency. 
4. To source talent and resources both from the market as well as within Government in the ICT domain 
to Ministries/ Departments on a chargeable basis under Central & State Government; a talent pool of 
technically skilled manpower for hardware, software, netw orks, cyber security and laws, standards, 
quality and testing, etc 
5. To promote innovation and evolve models for the empowerment of citizens and also  to promote 
participatory governance and citizen engagement across the government through various platforms 
including social media. 
6. Each IBD under DIC has specific roles and responsibilities and operates independently for its 
operations under the umbrella company of DIC. 
 
More details can be seen at https://dic.gov.in/ 
 
 
 
Position: Senior Manager – Training Development 
Vacancy: 1 Position 
Place of Posting: NeGD Delhi Office 
 
Job Summary:  
The objective of this role is to manage end-to-end conceptualization, design, administration, and execution 
of national and state-level digital governance training programs. 
 
The incumbent will drive digital learning transformation by creating high -quality, competency-based e-
learning content for  Mission Karmayogi (iGOT Karmayogi). Working in close coordination with MeitY , 
Central Line Ministries, State/UT Governments, academia, and industry partners, the officer will ensure 
institutional capacity building aligns directly with the vision of Digital India. 
 
 S/he will work closely with other members of the team to understand the requirement and ensure 
deliverables and deadlines.  
  
Duties and Responsibilities: 
• Identify the training and capacity-building needs. 
• Develop action plans based on the capacity -building roadmap and training strategy to achieve the 
project targets. 
• Support in defining learning objectives and key learning points and ensure they are addressed by the 
learning solution in conjunction with internal stakeholders.  
• Manage the content creation and development as per iGoT learning platform. 
• Build and manage  relationships with internal and external subject matter experts and other 
stakeholders. 
• Support in preparation of standard operation procedures/ guidelines for capacity-building activities. 
• Manage the implementation of various training programmes. 
• Provide training and awareness sessions for stakeholders on best practices. 
• Any other tasks assigned to the team.  
  
Essential qualification & experience: 
• Bachelor 's degree in Engineering, Technology, Human Resources, Organisational Development etc. 
• Total 8 years of experience in training and development.  
• With at least 4 years of experience in content development and management.  
  
Preferred qualification and experience 
• Master's degree in any discipline preferably in Management, Computer Science, Software Engineering 
or other related fields 
• Certifications in  Instructional Design , Digital Learning Standards  and related to Learning & 
Development 
• Working experience with the Government. 
• Experience in delivering sessions. 
• Strong communication skills (verbal and written).  
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.  
 
 
 
 
 
General Conditions applicable to all applicants covered under this advertisement  
 
1. Those candidates, who are already in regular or contractual employment under Central / State 
Government, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies, are expected to apply through proper 
channel or attach a ‘No Objection Certificate’ from the employer concerned with the application OR 
produce No Objection Certificate at the time of interview.  
2. The maximum age limit shall be 50 years on the closing date of receipt of application.  
3. NeGD reserves the right to fill all or some or none of the positions advertised without assigning any reason 
as it deems fit.  
4. The positions are purely temporary in nature for the project of NeGD/DIC and the appointees shall not 
derive any right or claim for permanent appointment at NeGD/DIC or on any vacancies existing or that 
shall be advertised for recruitment by NeGD in future.  
5. NeGD reserves the right to terminate the appointments of all positions with a notice of one month or 
without any notice by paying one month’s salary in lieu of the notice period.  
6. The designation of the selected candidates shall be mapped as per the existing designation policy of NeGD.

1. Job Description: Co-Lead – Digital Transformation & Strategy 
Role: Co-Lead (Digital Transformation & Strategy) 
Mapped Domain: Digital Governance & Policy, Data & Privacy, and Emerging Tech Integration 
Reporting to: Vice President / Head of Vertical, NeGD, Digital India Corporation 
Location: New Delhi, India 
 
About the Role 
We are actively seeking a highly motivated and seasoned professional to serve as Co -Lead – Digital 
Transformation & Strategy at NeGD. This leadership role is anchored within NeGD's strategic mandate to 
support Central Line Ministries, State Governments, and Union Territories in architecting, standardizing, and 
accelerating citizen-centric digital transformation under the Digital India initiative. 
 
The Co-Lead will spearhead the formulation of whole -of-government digital governance frameworks, policy 
guidelines, and data privacy baselines, while harmonizing these strategies with modern technological 
capabilities including Artificial Intelligence (AI) , Cloud Computing, Internet of Things (IoT), and Geographic 
Information Systems (GIS). In addition to technical policy and strategic advisory, the incumbent will actively 
lead Business Development engaging directly with government departments and public ag encies to identify 
institutional pain points, pitch NeGD advisory services, drive monetization/onboarding of national DPI 
platforms (such as DigiLocker, UMANG, and API Setu), and forge strategic partnerships across industry, 
academia, and bilateral/multilateral bodies. 
 
Roles & Responsibilities 
• Digital Governance & Policy Formulation:  Establish and execute a forward -looking digital governance 
roadmap. Draft techno -legal frameworks, interoperability standards, service -delivery benchmarks, and 
operational guidelines that set the digital practices for scalability, usability, accessibility , and reliability of 
government services. 
• Technical and Process Advisory:  Provide expertise for formulation of technology revamp of existing 
applications or development of new application taking due consideration to government process 
reengineering. 
• Handling Solution Architecture: Handle delivery of Business Architecture, Application Architecture, Data 
Architecture, Integration Architecture, Building Blocks and IT Governance including Data Governance. 
• Monitoring of Digital Governance Projects: Provide output / outcome matrix for the digital projects and 
suggest automated methods to monitor the progress of projects taking into consideration data analytics 
tools, alerts mechanism and escalation matrix. 
• Cross-Tech Advisory (AI, Cloud, IoT, GIS):  Act as the strategic bridge between policy and frontier 
technologies. Evaluate how emerging capabilities (AI decision systems, scalable sovereign cloud 
environments, IoT sensory networks, and GIS location intelligence) can be strategically infused into 
ministerial workflows to re-engineer government processes. 
• Business Development & Strategic Expansion:  Actively lead outreach and business development to 
expand NeGD's footprint across Central Line Ministries, State Departments, and autonomous entities. 
Formulate customized value propositions, lead consultative discovery sessions, secure MoUs, and position 
NeGD's digital products and consulting services. 
• Strategy Development & Stakeholder Engagement:  Conduct high-level policy consultation workshops 
with senior government leadership (Secretaries, IT Secretaries, State Mission Directors), industry bodies, 
think tanks, and startups to drive convergence and build consensus on digital transformation roadmaps. 
• Procurement Advisory & Model Frameworks: Create Model Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Expression 
of Interest (EoI) frameworks, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and Quality and Cost -Based Selection 
(QCBS) evaluation criteria for digital transformation and tech-policy consultancies. 
 
• Data Privacy & Regulatory Compliance:  Embed robust data governance, privacy -by-design principles, 
and compliance mechanisms (aligned with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act and relevant 
government regulations) across national and state-level digital initiatives. 
• Capacity Building & Knowledge Products: Curate policy briefs, white papers, readiness assessment tools, 
and institutional capacity-building programmes for administrative officers and State e-Governance Mission 
Teams (SeMTs). 
• Collaboration & Operational Alignment: Collaborate closely with other verticals within NeGD/DIC and 
Independent Business Divisions (such as IndiaAI, Bhashini, and MyGov) to deliver holistic digital solutions. 
 
Eligibility Criteria 
• Educational Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech / MCA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics 
& Communications or Equivalent and Master in Management, Public Policy or equivalent. 
• Total Work Experience:  Minimum 10+ years of professional experience in technology policy, digital 
governance, enterprise transformation, or public sector advisory. 
• Specialized Experience: 
o At least 5 years of experience in leading or managing large-scale Digital Governance / IT transformation 
projects with Central/State Governments, multilateral organizations. 
o At least 2 years of experience in software development in Government or Private Sector as well as at 
least 2 years of consulting experience in Government Sector. 
o At least conceptualisation, the design, development or deployment of AI enabled solutions or AI enabled 
workflows. 
o Proven track record in drafting and operationalizing public policy frameworks, digital standards, or data 
protection/privacy compliance workflows. 
o Demonstrated experience in Business Development, client relationship management, and consultative 
pitching within government, public enterprise, or smart governance sectors. 
o Demonstrated working comprehension and strategic application of emerging technologies including AI, 
Cloud Computing, IoT, and GIS in governance use cases. 
• Desired Certifications: PMP/PRINCE2, TOGAF, or relevant digital strategy certifications. 
 
Skills & Attributes 
• Comprehensive understanding of digital governance, government structures, administrative processes, 
General Financial Rules (GFR), and public procurement mechanisms. 
• Good understanding of Laws, Acts, Rules or regulations related to Digital Governance. 
• Exceptional consultative, business development, and client engagement skills with proven ability to 
interface with senior bureaucrats and CXO-level industry executives. 
• Strong techno-policy research, analytical thinking, and strategic roadmap drafting abilities. 
• Outstanding oral and written communication skills for authoring cabinet notes, white papers, model RFPs, 
and executive presentations. 
• Leadership capability to mentor cross-functional cohorts and balance competing priorities in a fast-paced 
environment. 
 
 
2. Job Description: Co-Lead – Digital Infrastructure & Cyber Security 
Role: Co-Lead (Digital Infrastructure & Cyber Security) 
Mapped Domain: Cyber Security, Cloud Security & Digital Infrastructure Security 
Reporting to: Vice President / Head of Vertical, NeGD, Digital India Corporation 
Location: New Delhi, India 
 
About the Role 
NeGD is looking for an experienced cyber security professional to serve as Co-Lead – Digital Infrastructure & 
Cyber Security. Working alongside the Practice Lead, the Co -Lead will help strengthen the cyber security 
posture of government digital platforms a nd infrastructure, advise Central Ministries and States/UTs on 
secure cloud and infrastructure adoption, lead cyber security capacity building initiatives for government 
officials, and support the growth of NeGD's advisory engagements in this area. 
 
Roles & Responsibilities 
• Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure Modernization: Advise Ministries, Departments and States/UTs on 
cyber security policies, frameworks, audits and incident response, in line with CERT -In and MeitY 
guidelines. 
• Secure Cloud & Infrastructure: Support secure adoption of MeitY-empanelled cloud and government data 
centre infrastructure, including DR/BCP planning. 
• Business Development: Facilitate new engagements with existing and new Ministries, Departments and 
States/UTs for NeGD's cyber security and infrastructure advisory services. 
• Technical Appraisal:  Review DPRs, infrastructure proposals and security architectures submitted by 
Departments. 
• Procurement Support: Help draft RFPs, technical specifications and SLAs for security and infrastructure 
services such as SOC, VAPT and cloud hosting. 
• Capacity Building: Plan and run cyber security capacity building initiatives for government, including the 
CISO Deep Dive trainings, cyber security courses on iGOT Karmayogi, and workshops, table -top exercises 
and cyber drills for CISOs, Deputy CISOs, officials and technical teams of Central Ministries and States/UTs. 
Develop training content, track participation and outcomes, and coordinate delivery with CERT -In, 
academia and industry partners. 
• Ecosystem Coordination:  Work with CERT -In, NCIIPC, STQC, cloud service providers and industry 
partners. 
 
Eligibility Criteria 
• Educational Qualification:  B.E. / B.Tech / MCA or equivalent in Computer Science, Information 
Technology, Cyber Security, Electronics & Communication or a related discipline. A post -graduate degree 
is desirable but not mandatory. 
• Total Work Experience: Minimum 10 years of experience in IT / digital infrastructure and cyber security, 
including at least 5 years in cyber security. 
• Specialized Experience: 
o Hands-on experience in one or more of: security architecture, SOC operations, VAPT / security audits, 
incident response or cloud security. 
o Experience of working with Government, PSUs or large enterprises is desirable. Experience in designing 
or delivering cyber security training and capacity building programmes is an added advantage. 
• Desired Certifications: Preferred, not mandatory – CISSP, CISM, CEH, CCSP or an equivalent cloud security 
certification. 
 
Skills & Attributes 
• Good understanding of cloud, data centre and network security. 
• Working knowledge of the IT Act, DPDP Act, CERT-In directions and CII/NCIIPC norms. 
• Good communication, documentation and stakeholder management skills. 
• Ability to work with senior government officials and multi-disciplinary teams. 
 
3. Job Description: Co-Lead – Emerging Technologies 
Role: Co-Lead (Emerging Technologies) 
Mapped Domain: Enterprise Solutions with AI/ML 
Reporting to: Vice President / Head of Vertical, NeGD, Digital India Corporation 
Location: New Delhi, India 
 
About the Role 
We are actively seeking an exceptional technologist and strategic evangelist to serve as Co -Lead – Emerging 
Technologies at NeGD. This position acts as the institutional anchor for ideating, prototyping, scaling, and 
operationalizing Artificial Intelligenc e and Machine Learning solutions across public governance, while 
integrating complementary emerging disciplines such as Blockchain, Internet of Things (IoT), and Drones/GIS. 
The Co -Lead will advise Central Line Ministries and State Governments on the entire lifecycle of AI/ML 
interventions—ranging from problem statement framing and model validation to ethical AI guardrails and 
production-grade integration with core digital pla tforms. Furthermore, the incumbent will head Business 
Development for the emerging tech vertical—engaging user ministries (such as Agriculture, Health, Education, 
Revenue, and Urban Development), creating scalable pilot concepts, securing project funding/s anctions, and 
building productive partnerships with deep -tech startups, industry accelerators, and premier research 
institutions. 
 
Roles & Responsibilities 
• AI/ML Solution Architecture & Prototyping:  Lead the technical conceptualization, design, and pilot 
development of state -of-the-art AI/ML and Generative AI applications for governance (e.g., automated 
document processing, computer vision for scheme monitoring, predictive citizen service delivery, a nd 
NLP/conversational interfaces). 
• Cross-Disciplinary Emerging Tech Integration:  Evaluate and architect end -to-end solutions 
incorporating complementary emerging technologies: 
o Blockchain: For tamper-proof public registries, credential issuance, and land/supply chain traceability. 
o Internet of Things (IoT):  For smart sensors, environmental monitoring, smart meters, and public 
utility optimization. 
o Drones, Aerial & GIS Tech:  For spatial mapping, agricultural crop assessment, infrastructure 
surveying, and disaster management. 
• Business Development & Project Sanctions:  Actively engage with Central Ministries and State Line 
Departments to assess digital bottlenecks, author concept notes, present high -impact use case 
demonstrations, and secure client buy-in and project funding for emerging tech deployments. 
• Ethical AI & Responsible Tech Frameworks: Define guidelines for ethical AI, algorithmic transparency, 
bias mitigation, explainability, and data security in public decision systems. 
• Procurement Toolkit & Innovation Challenges: Develop Model RFPs, Technical Evaluation Frameworks, 
and outcome-based SLAs for procuring deep-tech, AI/ML, and IoT systems. Organize national Hackathons, 
Grand Challenges, and Sandboxes in partnership with startups and incubators. 
• Technical Appraisal & Advisory: Appraise AI/ML DPRs submitted by states, evaluating training dataset 
viability, compute requirements, algorithmic soundness, and deployment architectures. 
• Capacity Building & Knowledge Dissemination: Curate executive masterclasses, developer workshops, 
and practical AI toolkits for government officers, State e-Governance Mission Teams, and technical staff. 
• Ecosystem Partnerships:  Work in deep synergy with IndiaAI, Bhashini, MeitY Startup Hub (MSH), 
academic institutions (IITs/IIITs), and leading industry consortia. 
 
Eligibility Criteria 
• Educational Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech / M.Sc / MCA / MBA / Ph.D. in Computer Science, 
Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related Software technical fields. 
 
• Total Work Experience: Minimum 8+ years of professional experience in technology development, data 
science, and IT project implementation. 
• Specialized Experience: 
o At least 4 years of specialized experience in designing, building, and deploying production -grade AI / 
Machine Learning solutions through their full lifecycle. 
o Demonstrated hands-on familiarity with modern ML/DL frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow), NLP/LLM 
fine-tuning, computer vision, and API-based model serving. 
o Demonstrated working comprehension and project experience interfacing AI with adjacent frontier 
technologies (Blockchain, IoT, Drone/GIS systems). 
o Proven track record in Business Development, use case commercialization, tech advocacy, or client 
solution consulting in public or enterprise domains. 
• Desired Certifications: Professional AI/ML certifications (Google Cloud Professional ML Engineer, AWS 
Certified Machine Learning - Specialty, or equivalent). 
 
Skills & Attributes 
• Deep technical expertise across algorithms, neural network architectures, edge deployment, and cloud -
based AI infrastructure. 
• Strong entrepreneurial mindset with proven capability to originate new business opportunities, engage 
ministerial clients, and communicate complex tech concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 
• Familiarity with public procurement policies, RFP evaluation criteria, and government contracting 
guidelines. 
• Strong published research, white paper authorship, or recognized open -source contributions are highly 
desirable. 
• Agile project management skills with ability to lead high-performing, technical cross-functional teams. 
 
 
4. Job Description: Co-Lead – Data Analytics & Business Intelligence (BI) 
Role: Co-Lead (Data Analytics & Business Intelligence) 
Mapped Domain: Big Data Analytics, Decision Intelligence, Large ETL & Data Governance 
Reporting to: Vice President / Head of Vertical, NeGD, Digital India Corporation 
Location: New Delhi, India 
 
About the Role 
We are actively seeking a dynamic and accomplished data leader to serve as Co -Lead – Data Analytics & 
Business Intelligence (BI) at NeGD. In an era where data-driven decision-making is central to governance, this 
role acts as the driving force behind NeGD' s initiatives to unlock the value of public data across Central 
Ministries and State Line Departments. 
 
The Co -Lead will lead the architecture and deployment of Big Data pipelines, scalable ETL/ELT 
transformations, enterprise data warehouses/data lakes, and executive interactive Business Intelligence 
dashboards that monitor national schemes and socioeconomic  outcomes. Crucially, the incumbent will 
spearhead Business Development —positioning NeGD's data analytics, visual analytics, and decision 
intelligence offerings to government departments, securing funded analytics mandates, onboarding 
administrative agenci es onto centralized dashboards, and leading collaborations with public policy and 
analytics partners. 
 
Roles & Responsibilities 
• Big Data Architecture & Pipeline Engineering:  Architect and oversee the implementation of robust, 
high-throughput Big Data analytics platforms, data warehouses, and data lakes capable of aggregating 
terabyte/petabyte-scale data from heterogeneous government databases. 
• ETL/ELT Transformation & Data Quality:  Define enterprise data integration strategies, automated 
ETL/ELT pipelines, data cleansing protocols, metadata management, and master data management (MDM) 
systems to ensure high fidelity, timeliness, and veracity of public data. 
• Executive BI Dashboards & Decision Intelligence:  Direct the design and rollout of national and state -
level KPI dashboards, interactive visual analytics tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Superset), and automated 
MIS reports for Secretaries, Ministers, and District Collectors. 
• Business Development & Client Expansion: Lead business development initiatives to identify analytics 
and reporting requirements across central line ministries, departments, and state governments. Build 
compelling dashboard prototypes, pitch NeGD's analytics capability, draft project proposals, a nd secure 
project sanctions. 
• Data Governance & Interoperability Standards:  Establish data governance protocols, data lineage 
tracking, standardized taxonomy, and secure data -sharing frameworks (compliant with National Data 
Sharing and Accessibility Policy - NDSAP and DPDP provisions). 
• Procurement Toolkit for Analytics & BI: Formulate Model RFPs, Scope of Work (SoW), and SLA metrics 
for procuring Big Data platforms, BI tooling licenses, analytics consulting services, and data engineering 
managed services. 
• Capacity Building & Data -Driven Culture: Conduct sensitization workshops, training bootcamps, and 
analytics clinics for government decision-makers and SeMT consultants to foster an institutional culture of 
data-backed policymaking. 
• Technical Appraisal & Advisory: Review and appraise DPRs and proposals concerning data warehousing, 
reporting tools, and predictive analytics platforms submitted to NeGD/MeitY. 
 
Eligibility Criteria 
• Educational Qualification: Graduate or Post Graduate Degree in Information Technology, Computer  
Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Analytics, Economics, or related quantitative disciplines. 
 
• Total Work Experience:  Minimum 8+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data 
warehousing, BI development, and enterprise data analytics. 
• Specialized Experience: 
o At least 4 years of hands -on experience executing large -scale Big Data analytics projects involving 
complex ETL transformations, schema modeling, and high-volume transactional data. 
o Good understanding of Data Architecture, AI/ML, AI tools and Infra. 
o Proven expertise in modern data stack technologies: Big Data processing (Hadoop, Spark, Presto), ETL 
tools (Fivetran, Informatica, Airflow, dbt), databases (PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Snowflake, Redshift), and 
BI platforms (Tableau, Power BI, Apache Superset). 
o Demonstrated success in Business Development, client discovery, pre-sales solutioning, or institutional 
partner onboarding in data analytics/IT domains. 
o Proficiency in SQL, Python, or R for data wrangling, statistical analysis, and predictive modeling. 
• Desired Certifications:  Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP), Tableau Certified 
Desktop/Server Specialist, Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate, or AWS/Azure Data 
Engineer Associate. 
 
Skills & Attributes 
• Demonstrated ability to use BI Tools like Power BI, Tableau, Python and open-source tools like Looker and 
Grafana. 
• Able to translate complex, messy administrative data into intuitive, executive -level visual stories and 
actionable insights. 
• Strong commercial orientation and consultative communication skills to identify institutional gaps and 
convert them into structured consulting assignments. 
• Comprehensive understanding of government operational environments, KPI tracking, and monitoring of 
national welfare and infrastructure schemes. 
• Exceptional problem-solving abilities, high analytical rigor, and attention to detail. 
• Proven leadership skills in managing data engineers, BI developers, and data analysts.

as it deems fit.

5. NeGD reserves the right to terminate the appointments of all positions with a notice of one month or

Subject: Filling up the post of Director General, Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (DG, 
ICERT) - regarding 
 
The Government of India enacted the Information Technology Act, 2000 to provide legal 
recognition for electronic transactions and to facilitate electronic governance. Section 2(ua) of the 
Information Technology Act, 2000 defines the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (ICERT) as 
an agency established under sub -section (1) of Section 70B of the Act. Section 70B of the Information 
Technology Act, 2000 provides that the Central Government shall, by notification in the Official Gazette, 
appoint an agency of the Government to be called the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team and 
shall provide the agency with a Director General and such other officers and employees as may be 
prescribed. 
 
2. Applications are invited for appointment to the post of Director General, Indian Computer 
Emergency Response Team (DG, ICERT) in accordance with the provisions contained in the Information 
Technology (Salary, Allowances and Terms & Conditions of Service of  the Director General, Indian 
Computer Emergency Response Team) Rules, 2012.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology 
Standardisation, Testing & Quality Certification (STQC) Directorate 
 
Standardisation Testing and Quality Certification (STQC) Directorate, an attached office of the 
Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India, provides quality 
assurance services in the area of Electronics and IT through countrywide networ k of Laboratories and 
Centres. The services include  Testing, Calibration, IT & e -Governance,  Training  and  Certification 
having National / International accreditation and recognitions in the area of testing and calibration.  
Besides a network of Electronics Regional Test Laborator ies (ERTLs) /Electronics Test and 
Development Centres (ETDCs)/Centre for Reliability (CFR)  which are primarily engaged in testing and 
calibration services, STQC has specialized institutions such as Indian Institute of Quality Management 
(IIQM) for quality related training programmes and Centre for Reliability (CFR) for reliability related 
services.  STQC supports Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology’s initiatives in the key 
areas like e -Government, e-Industry, e-Innovation / R&D, e -Learning, e-Security, e-Inclusion, Internet 
Governance through Quality & Security evaluations of IT systems and other projects of national 
importance 
 
2. STQC Directorate requires the services of suitable officers and staff with excellent service 
records and work exper ience from Central/State Government on deputation basis initially for a period 
of two years for the posts of Joint Director , Private Secretary, Assistant Section Officer , Personal 
Assistant, Staff car Driver Grade-I and Staff Car Driver Grade-II. Details of the same are given below:-

U R Rao Satellite Centre (URSC) situated in Bengaluru of Karnataka State is the lead centre of ISRO for satellite technology. URSC

edge technologies of relevance to its activities and infrastructures set -up for design, development, fabrication and testing of

one of the largest domestic communication satellite systems in Asia -Pacific region and Indian Remote Sensing (IRS) system which 
is one of the largest constellations  of earth observation satellites in operation. NAVigation with Indian Constellation (NAVIC) an 
independent Indian Satellite based regional positioning system with a constellation of seven satellites for critical national  
applications will be operational sh ortly. The Space science missions like Chandrayaan -1, Mars Orbiter Mission, Chandrayaan -3, 
Aditya-L1 and Astrosat have received World Wide acclaim and put India in the global map while at the same time inspiring the Gen
